stem: Based on the excerpt, which effect did this amendment have on women in U.S. society?

options.label: A
options.text: Women achieved freedoms identical to those of men.

options.label: B
options.text: Women continued to fight for their civil rights.

options.label: C
options.text: Women were unable to serve in the federal legislature.

options.label: D
options.text: Women were unable to participate in higher education.

visual_elements: The Nineteenth Amendment officially eliminated sex as a barrier to voting throughout the United States. . . . And yet, the legacy of the Nineteenth Amendment . . . turned out to be complicated. It advanced equality between the sexes but left . . . inequalities of class, race, and ethnicity intact. It stimulated important policy changes but left many reform goals unachieved. It helped women, above all white women, find new footings in government agencies, political parties, and elected offices . . . and yet left most outside the halls of power.
